name: GaussianRasterizer_w_pose
definition: A variant of the Gaussian rasterizer that accepts camera rotation and translation deltas (theta, rho) to render the scene with pose perturbations, returning an additional count of touched pixels (n_touched).
summary: GaussianRasterizer_w_pose is a Gaussian rasterizer variant that accepts camera rotation and translation deltas to render scenes with pose perturbations and returns pixel touch counts for optimization feedback.
